description: Na₄Si₃(GeO₆)₂ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.80 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.46 Å. Ge is bonded to six O atoms to form GeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.88 Å) and three longer (1.95 Å) Ge-O bond lengths. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent GeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-35°. There are two shorter (1.63 Å) and two longer (1.64 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Ge, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₃SiGe trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ge, and one Si atom.
